findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have a matching right. Because work done during the notice period is paid, this is a low-level risk.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement, at any time, upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
